area: Ecology: flora limbs (Spindle, PhyllotacticFlora, BranchingFlora, SpindleLodSystem)
summary: A flora limb that has finished evaporating now goes back to a pool (SpindlePool) and is reused by the next growth step instead of being destroyed and cloned; Spindle gained a reset-to-fresh-clone path and its Start work became Begin(), run again on reuse. PhyllotacticFlora and BranchingFlora take limbs from the pool and check a limb is still theirs before growing from it. AssembledFlora is unchanged. SpindleLodSystem gained two profiler markers only. Why: cloning limbs was the largest in-game stall in the Bloomrush and Sirocco profiles. Compiled in the editor, not played.
